versions.changelog:
Initial release of autopieceone – Piece One 自动移动脚本

- Automates character movement in the piece.one web game via OpenClaw.
- Randomly moves the character around a central circle and performs actions like clicking, dropping items, chatting, and changing colors.
- Automatically sets character name and color at startup.
- Includes concise setup instructions and command references for Windows, Mac, and Linux.
- Provides guidelines for updating and restarting the script.
